tips.text: Check Ticker on every Fortuna visit; he always stocks Debt-Bond cases and saves hours of bounty grinding, especially for Medical.
Run the Eudico bounty tier that drops the bond you need: Training from tier 1, Shelter from tier 2, Medical from tier 3.
Finish every bonus objective; its reward rolls on the final-stage table, where bonds drop most often.
Run the whole bounty; quitting after Stage 1 gives no Debt-Bonds.
Run the bounties solo; case objectives fill several times faster than in a squad.
Mine with the Sunpoint Plasma Drill and a Resourceful Retriever beast; half an hour fills several days of standing cap and finds the Goblite and Venerol for the Model.
Switch to Conservation once you reach Doer, with Equinox or Ivara putting animals to sleep for near-guaranteed perfect captures.
Take a 2,000-standing refinement blueprint as the free Outworlder rank-up item.
Leave Hard Engage off while levelling; it stops the MOA using its gun and other precepts.
Skip Emotion Modules while levelling; the MOA stops to emote after kills.
Expect a few days of bounties and mining, then two levelling passes; the grind is far milder than its old reputation.
Players keep a Nychus MOA afterward for Blast Shield rather than only feeding it to Mastery.
